artboards.title: B — One row, quiet acts fold

annotations.text:
Say who is carrying it, then press the button.

The footer was drawn for ONE select. Hired transport asks for four fields, the client's own person for three — and every label is hidden, so they land as anonymous boxes stacked in a 248px column.

Three answers to "where do four fields go". Pick one and I'll build it.

My pick: A.

Smallest change from the handoff, keeps the form and the button it arms next to each other, and every box gets a caption. The cost is one extra row on the common case — one of ours needs no details at all.

All three respond: change the carrier and watch the row.
